description: This file defines API route handlers for calendar availability management, including authentication middleware, and handlers for GET, POST, and DELETE HTTP methods related to user calendar selections.

methods.name: authMiddleware
methods.description: Authenticates user session and retrieves user credentials, throws error if not authenticated.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve user's connected calendars with selection status.

methods.name: postHandler
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a user's calendar selection.

methods.name: deleteHandler
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a user's calendar selection.
